game:sl-guide-text:
Seraph Leveling
Experience outranks everything.

Lore
As a Seraph, you lived a full life as a human. But you are not a human anymore. You were chosen for something greater, chosen to become something greater.
Only through work, and time, can you forge yourself into your greatest version.

Your class traits are a starting point, not a ceiling. Doing a thing trains the trait behind it, and a class penalty is paid off first before the bonus starts to show. Open the handbook page Seraph Leveling: My Progress to see your exact numbers for every skill, or type /trait all in chat (/trait mining and so on for one skill). Progress is saved per player in the world.

Stat skills
Mining (Hardy): mine stone (1 point) and ore (5 points). Each pickaxe type tracks its own progress, so rotating pickaxes levels faster. Up to +50% mining speed.
Melee (Soldier): deal melee damage. Tracked per weapon type. Up to +50% damage.
Ranged (Focused): deal ranged damage. Tracked per bow and arrow pair. Up to +50% damage, accuracy and range.
Walking (Fleetfooted): walk. 1000 blocks per level at first. Up to +15% speed.
Hunger: stay at full saturation. Every stretch of time at full counts. Up to -25% hunger rate.
Armor (Soldier): wear armor. Each new armor type gives a first-equip bonus, and time in armor builds more. Up to +50% durability and -50% walk speed penalty.
Mender: repair clothing and armor with a sewing kit. Up to +20% durability.
Pilferer: open collapsed chests and break loot vessels in ruins. Up to +20% rusty gears and vessel loot.
Resourceful: harvest animals with a knife. Up to +20% loot and +25% harvest speed.
Forager: harvest wild crops, berries, mushrooms and flowers. Up to +20% foraging loot.
Furtive: sneak. 100 blocks sneaked per level at first. Animals notice you from up to 35% closer than before.
Precise: damage locusts, bells and other mechanicals. Up to +30% damage against them.

Unlock traits
Clothier: wear 20 different clothing items to craft sewing kits.
Technical: repair 5 translocators; they then cost one gear less.
Hardy Health: reach 10% mining speed and 10% armor durability for +5 health.
Bowyer: 10% ranged damage plus 300 damage with a simple bow or longbow unlocks crude bows and arrows.
Improviser: 300 damage with thrown stones unlocks the sling.
Tinkerer: Technical plus 10% Precise unlocks the tuning spear.
Merciless: 10% armor durability plus 15% melee damage unlocks the Blackguard shortsword and shield.
Claustrophobic (Hunter) is removed outright once mining reaches its threshold.

Negative traits
A class penalty on a stat is cancelled level by level before the bonus appears, so a Hunter's Farsighted melee penalty is gone after 15 melee levels and the bonus starts from there. In the end every class can reach the same totals, unless the server turns on class cap offsets.

Combat Overhaul
With Combat Overhaul or its community fork installed, weapon proficiencies (bows, firearms, melee weapons, poleaxes) level the same way and their negative traits are paid off the same way.

For server owners
ModConfig/SeraphLeveling.json holds every cap and rate, plus optional rules: GlobalXPRateMultiplier, DeathPenaltyFullReset, EnableClassCapOffsets, CancelNegativeTraits, HungerSaturationThresholdPercent, skill decay, the sleep buff, and the off-by-default temporal and weapon-speed traits. Reload it in game with /trait reloadconfig. Admins move progress between worlds with /trait export and /trait import, and edit players with /trait setplayer, /trait resetplayer and /trait resetall.
